observed_gaps.fact: stdin accepts effect ACK only; main awaits one prompt then exits; no command identity/control.
queue_empty only means Acknowledged==Frames, not command consumption or SDK queue empty.
Synchronous brokerEffect can block control receipt ingestion during model/tool call.
CANCEL cannot target Goal or pending Task via its Goal before Run exists.
Idempotency replay returns stored pending ACK forever unless a new monotonic completion mechanism exists.
Interactive loop synchronously runs runCLIVerb and does not consume unbuffered input while execution is active.

storage_decision.recommended: Real numbered0022 migration with four relational tables; frozen public/domain schemas unchanged.

putOpaque_assessment.full_snapshot: VACUUM INTO copies opaque current rows and inventory hashes them. This is byte inclusion, not full restore support.
putOpaque_assessment.portable: backupPortable reads domain_versions only; putOpaque rows are omitted.
putOpaque_assessment.same_host_upgrade: putOpaque writes only domain_objects. backup_upgrade.go:449 requires matching domain_versions; new opaque queue rows fail UPGRADE_CURRENT_HISTORY_BINDING.
putOpaque_assessment.ordinary_put_alternative: New versioned kind requires a contract; RestoreBackup validates every domain_versions kind against frozen Contracts at backup.go:621. An unknown queue kind fails.
putOpaque_assessment.conclusion: Opaque-only is not approved as a complete no-migration solution; no broad unknown-kind or history exemptions.

migration_constraints: 0021 already exists. Root reserves0022 after checking concurrent scope. Service.New enumerates numbered SQL automatically, so store.go need not change. A fresh install must not query client_sessions until its additive schema exists.
Keep CheckMigrationSafety: populated databases require matching-program backup and isolated restore migration. Do not evade this by adding unnumbered queue SQL to next_v24_sessions.sql.

Current fixed upgrade supports13/14/20, not21/22. Add explicit21-to22 plan with exact hashes and isolated destination. Preserve all previous plan behavior and protected/history policies. Unrelated existing opaque-row incompatibility is a separate baseline problem, never grounds for a broad exemption.
Migration and current backup/restore/rebackup are enabling gates. Storage-only implementation cannot declare the queue slice complete.

tables.client_command_queue: PK(principal,project,command_id), UNIQUE(session_id,enqueue_sequence); immutable request hash, exact text/attachment refs, message_id, mode, accepted writer epoch, Goal/Task, fixed eventual Run/runtime epoch/dispatch binding; state+revision and last receipt reference.
tables.client_queue_fences: Per original Task/Run generation; OPEN/SEALING/SEALED/CANCEL_FENCED/RECONCILING, next sequence and closed-through watermark; dispatch/process identity and restore fence. Shared transaction arbitrates claim/enqueue/seal/cancel.
tables.client_control_requests: Original Run/Goal cancel command, frozen owned Task set, stable control_request_id, REQUESTED/RECONCILING/CONFIRMED, request hash and target settlement facts. Not a new business scheduling authority.
tables.client_control_receipts: Append-only transition/frame evidence, exact binding and hashes; identical duplicate only. Current row transition must reference receipt; no DELETE/UPDATE of receipt history.

queue_state_machine.authority: Go SQLite is sole business authority. New tables are internal operational data, not a new frozen domain kind. Existing scheduler remains sole Goal/Task/Run creator and claimer.
enqueue_transaction: Authenticate existing writer/lease; check exact binding, request hash, session revision, writer epoch, runtime epoch and OPEN fence; do not relax qualified runtime admission.

Allocate monotonically increasing per-bound-queue order and command/message IDs; preserve original text and attachment provenance. Apply bounded capacity and transport representability before acceptance.
Atomically persist entry, accepted watermark, MESSAGE event, original idempotency result and session revision. COMPLETED SendMessageResult proves durable enqueue only; no additional Goal/Task/Run.
phases: ENQUEUED -> SENDING (persist before process write) -> SDK_ACCEPTED -> CONSUMED
SENDING -> CONSUMED allowed when authenticated exact SDK consumption witness arrives before method/accepted receipt; late acceptance verifies identity without state regression.
ENQUEUED -> DROPPED only under committed cancellation/fence proof before any dispatch.
SENDING or SDK_ACCEPTED -> DROP_REQUESTED -> DROPPED requires exact SDK clear plus idle/dead-process and receipt reconciliation.
Any ambiguous transport/process/restore boundary -> UNKNOWN; do not silently re-enqueue. UNKNOWN remains unsettled until reconciled by original evidence.
queue_state_machine.history: Append-only receipt transitions retain prior acceptance/consumption evidence. CONSUMED is not rewritten to DROPPED during cancellation. An accepted send response stays its original enqueue result even if downstream later fails; snapshot/events reflect later state.
queue_state_machine.fences: OPEN -> SEALING -> SEALED; cancellation/restore can fence at any phase. Writer handoff never erases accepted commands. Prior-writer commands already legally accepted retain original identity; newly submitted stale-writer or stale-runtime commands reject.
queue_state_machine.public_contract: Only existing schema fields/event kinds. pending_command_ids is derived from actual outstanding queue/control records. No invented QUEUE event, Task cancel target, command cancel verb or claim that downstream consumption is SendMessageResult completion.

mu_control_design.chosen_adapter: Use actual AgentSession.sendCustomMessage({customType: internal queue marker, content: original content, display: true, details: {command_id, queue_generation, queue_sequence, content_hash}}, {deliverAs: steer|followUp, triggerTurn: true}) on the existing AgentSession. No vendor changes.
mu_control_design.source_basis: agent-session.ts custom messages reach agent.steer/followUp while streaming and _runAgentPrompt while idle; messages.ts convertToLlm maps custom content to role=user unchanged and omits details/customType. Repeated identical text remains distinguishable by details.command_id in message events.
required_proof: Exercise the installed SDK, not a mocked session method. Capture actual outgoing model request and prove complete original user content and attachment handling, no metadata instructions, no duplication, and exactly matched message_start/end receipts.
Validate allowable attachments against the installed custom-message conversion; reject unsupported representations before enqueue success rather than silently dropping attachments.

Observe real underlying agent queue/idle state. AgentSession.pendingMessageCount and clearQueue returned text lists omit custom messages and cannot prove emptiness. Keep a bounded per-command adapter ledger and inspect supported underlying agent queue state.
mu_control_design.frame_binding: Strict bounded fields include full original process/dispatch/epoch/generation identity and per-command IDs/hashes. Unknown/stale/foreign/duplicate conflicting receipts fail closed. Same exact duplicate receipt is idempotent. Control receipts participate in ordered bridge journal durability.
concurrency: Do not await delivery/idle-triggered SDK prompt completion inside the stdin frame reader; it must continue accepting effect acknowledgements and abort. Serialize SDK decisions through one adapter actor while reader remains responsive.

Make stdout sequence allocation and pending-ACK registration atomic before asynchronous writes. Current next=sequence+1 pattern must not race newly concurrent events. One process stdin writer serializes effect ACKs and control frames.

Current coordinator synchronous brokerEffect wait cannot block control delivery/receipt processing. Add bounded transport/read pump and cancellation propagation while retaining existing single effect/business authority.

Mark command consumption synchronously in SDK message events, flush bounded receipt writes before idle/seal completion. Serialize streaming/idle/settling transitions to prevent an admitted command from falling after worker disposal.

Honor cancellation in real pending MODEL/tool effects and AbortSignal. session.abort waiting for idle cannot depend forever on a pending protocol.effect acknowledgement. Keep physical-process-stop fallback and distinguish forced termination from SDK acknowledgement.
mu_control_design.budgets: All steer/followUp turns share the original Task/Run/process/session, capability envelope and total effect/model/time/frame budgets. Do not reset counters, obtain another business Run or expand tool permissions. Preserve exact supplementary input provenance without mutating original frozen Task input references.
mu_control_design.qualification: Changing worker/bundle invalidates source-current qualification assumptions. Rebuild hashed runtime bundle and rerun applicable existing qualification gates; local SDK loopback tests do not establish LIVE provider acceptance.

normal_seal: At real SDK idle the worker remains alive. Host transaction changes OPEN to SEALING and records exact accepted high watermark; concurrent enqueue before fence is included, after fence is rejected before success.

Drain all legally accepted messages through actual SDK consumption or explicit reconciled disposition. Worker returns exact generation/watermark, adapter ledger and real SDK queue-empty/idle evidence.

Go verifies no nonterminal entries or outstanding controls, commits SEALED, then sends commit_seal. Only then may worker emit final turn.completed, result artifact and dispose. No orphan accepted message can survive terminal Run completion.
queue_empty_predicate: Canonical queue has no ENQUEUED/SENDING/SDK_ACCEPTED/DROP_REQUESTED/UNKNOWN entry in settled scope.
No pending control request or unprocessed bound receipt; accepted and sealed watermark/generation match.
Actual SDK queue and adapter ledger are empty with authenticated idle proof, or physical process termination plus sufficient exact command reconciliation proves no remaining execution.
Protocol Frames/Acknowledged is consistent but is not the user queue predicate.
children_stopped and EffectsReconciled remain separate mandatory facts; no unknown effect becomes success because messages were cleared.
completion_and_cancel.cancel_targets: Public Run/Goal only, per frozen schema. Goal cancel resolves and freezes owned task membership plus future admission; pending no-Run Task cancellation is internal through that Goal, not a new public target.
cancel_transaction: Record original CANCEL command id/hash and durable IN_PROGRESS/ACKNOWLEDGED response. Atomically fence target Goal/Run queues, record task cancel controls and prevent competing scheduler claim/new Task creation.

Use the same shared cancellation hooks from existing actGoal/controlTask and protocol entrypoints, so existing direct APIs cannot bypass queue fencing. CANCEL dominates PAUSE, resource permission recovery and resume.

For a no-Run Task, settle only after proof that no dispatch/process/effect was admitted; keep Run null and create no placeholder Run. For active tasks, issue same-worker clear/abort, cancel actual effects/children, then reconcile receipts and effects.

Complete original CANCEL response only when every target member is settled with true queue_empty, children_stopped and effect reconciliation. Preserve original request hash, monotonic response history and same-command replay identity. Goal status CANCELLED by itself is not this proof.
completion_and_cancel.unknowns: Transport loss, old process journal gaps or unknown effects remain pending/reconciling. Do not return settled=true or clear pending IDs to make UI appear terminal. Force-kill is evidence of stopped process, never fabricated SDK command acceptance/consumption.
completion_and_cancel.handoff_pause: Handoff preserves accepted followups and command IDs. If PAUSE is supported in this slice, it must use real same-worker suspension/abort and explicit resumable disposition under existing semantics; do not implement PAUSE by secretly cancelling queued inputs. Unsupported behavior remains explicit and must not be advertised as completed.
